_description: Offline fixtures for the KM-14955 Prader-Willi joint LLM+KG notebook. Counts match the 2026-08-07 ORBIT KG build / Data S5 trace.

sample_neighbourhood.cypher: MATCH (s:Sample {sample_id:'KM-14955'})-[r]->(x) RETURN type(r) AS rel, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC;

phenotypes.cypher: MATCH (s:Sample {sample_id:'KM-14955'})-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(p:Phenotype) RETURN p.id AS node, p.name AS phenotype;

rows.phenotype: PWS ARCOs exhibit increased fractions of KI67+ proliferating cells and NESTIN+ neural progenitors with reduced DCX+ and NeuN+ neurons compared with controls.
PWS ARCOs are significantly larger in projected area than control ARCOs at 40 and 70 DIV.

dlk1_markers.cypher: MATCH (s:Sample {sample_id:'KM-14955'})-[:HAS_GROUP_INFO]->(g:GroupInfo)-[:HAS_CLUSTER_MARKER]->(c:ClusterMarkers) WHERE toUpper(coalesce(c.symbol, c.name, '')) = 'DLK1' RETURN count(DISTINCT g) AS groups, count(DISTINCT c) AS marker_nodes, count(*) AS edges;

radial_glia_markers.cypher: MATCH (g:GroupInfo {GSE_ID:'GSE164102'})-[:HAS_CLUSTER_MARKER]->(c:ClusterMarkers) WHERE c.cluster = 'Radial glial cells' RETURN DISTINCT toUpper(coalesce(c.symbol, c.name, '')) AS symbol ORDER BY symbol;

dlk1_annotation.cypher: MATCH (s:Sample {sample_id:'KM-14955'})-[:HAS_GROUP_INFO]->(g:GroupInfo)-[:HAS_CLUSTER_MARKER]->(c:ClusterMarkers)-[:HAS_GENE_ANNOTATION]->(a:GeneAnnotation) WHERE toUpper(coalesce(c.symbol, c.name, '')) = 'DLK1' RETURN DISTINCT a.gene_annotation_entrez_id AS entrez, a.gene_annotation_gene_name AS gene_name, a.organism_species AS species, size(a.string_rows) AS string_partners, size(a.crispick_rows) AS crispick_designs;
